trends.name: Iran-US Military Escalation & Oil Markets
trends.summary: Trump threatens Iranian infrastructure strikes; 50% of Iran's missile launchers remain intact despite US-Israeli strikes. Oil prices spiked to $112/barrel with 63-hour trading closure. Energy costs cascading into food prices and Fed policy decisions.

trends.name: Energy Inflation Pressures Fed Policy
trends.summary: Fed's Williams signals energy price impacts on both inflation and disposable incomes. War-driven fuel costs appearing in gasoline prices ($4.09 AAA) and food indices. Higher energy creates dual mandate pressure: inflation vs. employment.

trends.name: Middle East Conflict Impact on Global Supply Chains
trends.summary: UN food price index rose 2.4% in March as conflict drives energy and freight costs higher. Global PMI shows manufacturing testing resilience amid surging prices and supply chain delays. Second consecutive monthly increase in food prices.

trends.name: Israeli-Hezbollah Conflict Implications
trends.summary: Israeli officials announce plans to disarm Hezbollah and prevent Lebanese refugee returns until security assured. Strategy explicitly decoupled from Iran file. Signals extended regional instability affecting Gulf financing for Wall Street deals.

trends.name: U.S. Labor Market Resilience & Jobs Report
trends.summary: U.S. payrolls added 178,000 in March, beating expectations; unemployment holds at 4.3%. Fed signals expectation for more modest hiring ahead with 'low hire, low fire' stability. Jobs data not yet reflecting energy price impacts.

trends.name: Tech Sector Geopolitical Vulnerability
trends.summary: Iran's Revolutionary Guard threatens attacks on U.S. tech companies ($NVDA, $AAPL exposed). Microsoft pushing Copilot sales amid AI anxiety. Geopolitical risk creating valuation pressure on mega-cap tech exposed to Middle East tensions.

trends.name: AI Investment & Strategic M&A Frenzy
trends.summary: Microsoft commits $10 billion AI push with SoftBank; Japan's Sakura Internet surges 20% on AI deals. OpenAI's TBPN acquisition signals aggressive but confusing M&A strategy. SpaceX IPO speculation adds to AI/space sector momentum.

trends.name: Chinese Chip Sector AI Boom & U.S. Sanctions
trends.summary: Chinese chip firms hit record high revenue driven by AI boom and U.S. export curbs. Sanctions paradoxically spurring domestic innovation and market consolidation. Key sector benefiting from AI demand while geopolitically fragmented.

trends.name: Airline Industry Pricing Adjustment & Margins
trends.summary: United Airlines increases checked bag fee by $10 amid rising fuel costs; launches premium Polaris basic fare restructure. Airlines testing pricing power on business travelers as energy inflation pressures margins.

trends.name: REIT Valuations & Property Market Disconnect
trends.summary: Three major disconnects identified between REIT pricing and underlying property values; Seritage downgraded for limited asset sale progress. Mortgage rates rising for fifth consecutive week (up since Iran conflict), creating refinancing headwinds for real estate sector.

trends.name: Consumer Discretionary Weakness & Cost Pressures
trends.summary: Starbucks turnaround efforts failed to move stock despite aggressive initiatives. Food/Easter costs surge to point parents substituting cheaper alternatives. Consumer resilience tested by inflation in essentials, pressuring discretionary spending.

trends.name: Trump Administration Political & Insider Trading Risks
trends.summary: Pam Bondi fired by Trump (prior 'Dow 50k' comment signals instability); Warner/Schiff probe potential insider trading in government. Tiger Woods' immediate Trump call after legal trouble signals political access concerns. Policy unpredictability weighing on market confidence.
